notes.title: Patch 1.3.5 and September Mid-Month
notes.content: [p]Check out what we've got in store for our September mid-month update:[/p][p][/p][h2]Salaryman Kragg Mid-Month Bundle[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="BrgblLuFC24;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Working a 9 to 5 isn’t for everyone, but someone’s gotta put rocks on the table. Make winning look like another day in the office with the Salaryman Kragg bundle - including the Salaryman Kragg skin, emote, icon, and platform! The bundle also includes 25,000 coins and 250 Aether bucks.[/p][p]This skin comes packed with custom voice lines on Neutral Special, Up Special, both taunts, self KO, Getup Special, and two more on his victory screen. [/p][p][/p][h2]New Shop Items[/h2][list][*][p]Midnight Abyss Zetterburn Palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/55fe99490301af6faf89a51996fbb517ee87540d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Purple Bandit Maypul Palette[/p][/*][*][p]Pink Ranno Palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/5b90bfbb8304dbe313b08ed25fc93889af3412ff.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Joltbeak Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Chillamari Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Avatar Kinguin Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Avatar Suttlebub Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Party Time Death Effect[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/2344bef028877ad974cb5c6bdb00d6a1d8a501c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Player-hosted Lobby Feature: Fair Lag for Host[/h2][p]We’ve added a new feature to player-hosted lobbies called "Fair Lag for Host". When enabled, this setting reduces host advantage by adding a delay for the host.[/p][p][/p][p]This is off by default but can be turned on from the bottom right of the lobby screen when listen-server is toggled on (where the region preference option normally is), alerting players in the lobby of the change. More details:[/p][list][*][p]This feature sets a delay and rollback frame that is determined to be fair based on the other players' connections in the lobby. Likely 1 frame above the connected player in a 1v1 to account for jitter.[/p][/*][*][p]For Lobby sizes 2-4. Players can create a public lobby on their machine and cap the player size if they are looking for nearby opponents.[/p][/*][*][p]Listen servers will now show local player NAT type and hosting player connection type (wired/wifi).[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/c4860a76df0a8148eaf8e111448532c3e049740b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Training Mode Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed menu state being out of sync after load state.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu state not resetting on match restart.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where CPU floorhug was not working due to floorhug logic change.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Rivals 2 Hits the Stage at UFA 2025
notes.content:
[p]Get ready for some EU Rivals as players flock to [url="https://ufa.gg"]Ultimate Fighting Arena 2025[/url] for a weekend at one of Europe's most legendary fighting game events. This official Rivals 2 Circuit Series event brings extra stakes to an already fierce competition, with circuit points and a cash prize on the line. [/p][p][/p][p][b]How to Watch[/b][/p][p]Tune into [url="https://twitch.tv/zdamascus"]twitch.tv/zdamascus[/url] Saturday Sept. 13th at 10am PT / 12pm CT / 1pm ET / 19:00 CEST to watch the Top 8 showdown as the Rivals UFA 25 champion is crowned. Check out the full bracket and more event details on [url="https://start.gg/ufa2025"]start.gg[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/a3f2ef4f0fb498d8b990206404dd98fb5e43093a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Rep the Palette and Support the event with creator code "UFA25"[/b][/p][p]To rep UFA in game, you can pick up the brand new UFA Slam Dunk Ranno palette bundle. Featuring fresh colors on our favorite frog, you can also support the event directly by entering creator code "UFA25" when picking up the palette, or [b]any[/b] other purchase in the shop. Don't forget using a creator code gets you extra Aether Bucks, and sends a portion of the purchase to the event, so it's a win-win. 

As with past bundles, if you already own the base skin, you’ll receive both the palette and an Aether Bucks refund to keep things fair when you buy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/f0627c610d19e7cc2aa90fb77002dc56ce74b827.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.4 Notes & Pirate's Tide Event LIVE
notes.content:
[h2][b]Pirate’s Tide Event[/b][/h2][p]Argh mateys, it’s time to roll out the canons and fire off our new event! The September Pirate’s Tide Event has Pirate Clairen, Pirate Absa, and Pirate Wrastor as featured skins with some wanted poster icons to match. The new cosmetics are paired with 25,000 Aether Coins and 250 Aether Bucks.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="MDzP2e-zDTY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Our free track for August contains the Pirate Wrastor emote, the piratesplosion death effect, pirate platform, Pirate Wrastor icon, and the Otter Maypul skin. Players equipping any event skins above, and the Pirate Maypul skin will receive 20% Bonus XP on the event track. There is also a new palette for Pirate Maypul in the in-game shop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/c6d9a2a40abe60d2250a47a0143f5c3d09502bd3.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Next R2CS Events: Riptide & Ultimate Fighting Arena[/b][/h2][p]After an incredibly packed August, we’re kicking off the second half of the R2CS! For North America we have Riptide 2025 and an Online event coming your way, while Europe has Ultimate Fighting Arena 2025 and an Online event of their own!
[/p][p]Last month, we revealed the Riptide Pool Party Ranno palette, which is still available in the shop to rep the event! Pick up the classic palette and rep Riptide to show your support.
[/p][p]Coming up on the European circuit is the massive Ultimate Fighting Arena 2025 event. We’ve worked with the organizers to create the UFA Slam Dunk Ranno palette bundle for players to rep the event, stay tuned later this week for the bundle![/p][p][/p][p]If you buy either of these bundles but already own the base skins, you’ll receive an Aether Bucks refund to make it even just like with our other bundles. Keep an eye out for more circuit palettes in the future as the second half of the R2CS is just beginning! These palettes are FREE for all players attending the respective events. [/p][p][/p][p]You can check out upcoming & past events and the region leaderboards on our[url="https://www.start.gg/league/rivals-2-championship-series/details"] [u]official league page[/u][/url].[/p][h2][b]New Shop Items[/b][/h2][list][*][p]CoolBlue Olympia Palette[/p][/*][*][p]Pink Leopard Shark Orcane Palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/a40a16bdf0972b72db78e2050fd5cb58e6a99dd0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Mint Bee Kragg Palette[/p][/*][*][p]Purple Spangled Wrastor Palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/085a35200a67c2e9d0c97025c2eaeb5da6ea972a.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Black Pirate Maypul Palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/30dbcc2fd6b2d9e4b540d37c5c1f70310d20fcfc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Kingoing Coin Flip Emote[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/cf4c1452603a69de65f49f62cd6e0f736492dfca.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Temple Fleet Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Clairen Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Forsburn Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Loxodont Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Maypul Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Orcane Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Wrastor Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Zetterburn Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Ranno Icon[/p][/*][*][p]Temple Kragg Icon[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d4d847f5a4ff2570bac86cacc9db6344eff2978a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Ranked Shop Update[/b][/h2][p]Champion Clairen has been added to the Ranked Shop! This includes a skin, two emotes, and two icons for the Flame’s Salvation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/39c1fcc1459b423ab073bcaa7cfa96c981e2c44a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Listen-servers for Lobby mode are here![/b][/h2][p]Today’s patch introduces a top-requested feature from players. We’ve added listen-server options to allow players to host matches in a public or private lobby directly off of their machine instead of through servers.[/p][list][*][p]Players can toggle the listen-server option from the same menu as the region override option.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d15c3e5594f3597c8861d12c54e48704c3bf1f0e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/c19d433a68421b0f7003aef37320e73d4c7cf8ae.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]BALANCE[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6fd9f9202f25816abe013a2383ac93093237b78f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Parrying after powershielding will no longer restore your momentum from when you started shielding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to freeze if an article was spawned between two pieces of solid ground (e.g. the stage and Kragg's pillar).[/p][/*][*][p]Canceling a waveland into a dash will now multiply your horizontal speed by 0.2 before applying your dash speed.[/p][list][*][p]This increases the speed of dashing after wavedashing in the other direction, as it felt a little too slow after the dash changes in 1.3.3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] The critical hit knockback threshold will now be adjusted for downward-sending moves the same way that it is for omnidirectional moves like Zetterburn Neutral Special and Up Special.[/p][list][*][p]This means that spikes will be able to activate the critical hit effect at more reasonable percents.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a vfx for untechable knockdowns.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Up Special will no longer start spinning when holding the right stick in a direction[/p][list][*][p]This allows Ranno to ASDI with the right stick without canceling Up Special into the spin.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/0d3c62f8c7d9f5d3289603c61f20645fe6ffe841.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Enemies will no longer be pushed out of Wrastor's ECB during Up Special's startup window.[/p][list][*][p]This prevents Wrastor from pushing enemies away from the sweetspot of the attack, which would occasionally cause it to whiff even if he was right next to them.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Dash Attack will no longer cancel parry stun when transitioning from ground to air.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7dd14ccb8acd3afd8f6b31257553bb3d9213766.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Pillar will no longer be broken by Clairen's plasma field's lingering hitbox.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/75dae4161d00c91e0abc8d6daa9fce66ac839b0c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Dash Attack hits 1 and 2 are no longer untechable.[/p][list][*][p]This was a leftover from when they were weaker than the final hit. Now that they have the same knockback, that is no longer necessary.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/80071214314eb0f5d582a31bebfef1823b2efedf.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Down Tilt tipper radius: 36cm > 25cm, hitbox moved forward 11cm.[/p][/*][*][p]Down Tilt outer sourspot radius: 45cm > 35cm, hitbox moved forward 10cm and upward 5cm.[/p][list][*][p]This preserves the forward range of the move while shrinking the vertical range, both upward and downward. This makes it less effective at poking recoveries unless they miss their sweetspot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b2464b84f836a99668d4d212cd534eac821662e7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Back Air's swipe adjusted to better match the hitboxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Ledge Attack active frames: 7 > 6[/p][list][*][p]We're removing the final active frame to make it not hit as low behind Clairen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/23dc9abcf3c0ec54b2a05561690db80b97d24479.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Forsburn's overhead HUD will now be disabled if he is touching smoke at all.[/p][list][*][p]This prevents it from giving his location away when traveling through a patchy cluster of smoke clouds. This also makes the overhead HUD visibility correspond with his ability to inhale smoke with Down Special, giving players an immediate way to tell if they're close enough to the smoke.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Smoke cloud hurtboxes radii: 120cm > 80cm.[/p][list][*][p]The enormous size of the hurtboxes made clearing smoke more forgiving than we would like.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/e15be25fdec1d9c2b907cb43ebe395eccff05fac.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Clone will now disappear 13 frames faster after detonating.[/p][/*][*][p]Clone detonation will now put Down Special on a 2 frame cooldown.[/p][list][*][p]This allows Forsburn to inhale smoke with Down Special immediately after the clone detonates instead of being arbitrarily locked out for a short duration.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Destroying your own clone by starting a Ledge Special or Getup Special will no longer put Forward Special on cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Up Special will now land instantly when teleporting into smoke with ground underneath it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/9f39c5bd5061caa1c4e3f06e0739027a7e68dba7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Max horizontal jump speed during Run Turn: 16 > 19.8[/p][list][*][p]This reverts his hydroplane jump speed to its pre-1.3.3 value, since getting a boost from Run Turn is his unique mechanic.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Forward Special is now visible during travel.[/p][list][*][p]Making it hittable but not visible was confusing, so we're making Orcane morph into a water ball instead of disappearing. Because the movement is extremely quick, Orcane's movement mixups are still unreactable even though it is now visible.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented Orcane from fastfalling during Forward Special's Special Fall window after the animation had looped.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/52adfc60212a20bdfb8ae15863b63498fc85bc17.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Up Special's maximum charge time can no longer decay lower than 25 frames.[/p][list][*][p]This means that he will always be able to at least halfway charge his Up Special.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug fix:[/b] Forward Strong will no longer lose ice armor when canceling into Up/Down Strong on the first 2 frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Up Strong hit 1 is no longer untechable.[/p][list][*][p]This was ported directly from Rivals 1, but ended up causing some overly-advantageous situations even when the correct counterplay was applied, such as when the opponent DIs to avoid hit 2 but then ends up landing on a platform.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/236f6b8bbcfdc86971744f8590e8596d2b1dcec2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Forward Special's cloud will now be destroyed if Absa gets hit before its active frames.[/p][list][*][p]This prevents it from hitting opponents after they interrupted Absa's Forward Special.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If Up Special part 1 is grounded on the frame that it would normally go into the Special Fall window, it will now go into a 9 frame grounded recovery window unless it hits an opponent.[/p][list][*][p]This makes it function similarly to Up Special part 2. Previously, Absa could avoid almost all of the landing lag of the move if she ended it a short distance above the ground, which was unintuitive/difficult to punish. The move still functions the same on hit, but will be more punishable on whiff when ending on/near the ground.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Up Special part 1 will no longer count as grounded if it travels upward and ends right above the ground.[/p][list][*][p]This removes a situation where Absa could avoid going into Special Fall after using part 1 to go upward right above the ledge, then going into the air with part 2.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Special Pummel's Static Electricity will now be removed from all opponents when Absa is KOd.[/p][/*][*][p]Forward Tilt part 1 backward range reduced by 20cm.[/p][list][*][p]This makes it less likely to hit opponents behind her.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/635d62efd812708271b1e791f01eeff8ee0a89df.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Forward Tilt part 2 can now clash with other Absa Forward Tilts.[/p][/*][*][p]Forward Strong inner multihit now reaches farther both upward and downward[/p][list][*][p]This should make it link into the final hit more reliably when clipping opponents with the inner corners of the move.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/01966384cdccba9294bf6df998e31d1988649090.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Up Strong hits 1 and 2 now reach 40cm higher.[/p][list][*][p]This makes them able to reach low platforms, increasing the move's usefulness in tech chasing below platforms.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/66936b93797417f86e99db332929aeee1d29b307.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Getup Attack will now lose its intangibility halfway through the active frames instead of being intangible for all of them.[/p][list][*][p]Her Getup Attack has extremely long active frames and a relatively short recovery window, so we're reducing the intangibility to be more in line with other characters' Getup Attacks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Rivals 2 Championship Series Fall/Winter Split Announcement
notes.content:
[p]The first half of the Rivals II Championship Series has been a wild ride so far - featuring record breaking events and players coming together from across the FGC to make their mark. With our Summer Split wrapping up with [url="https://www.start.gg/tournament/riptide-2025-4/details"][u]Riptide 2025[/u][/url] in North America, and [url="https://www.ufa.gg/"][u]Ultimate Fighting Arena 2025[/u][/url] in Europe both in just a couple weeks - it’s time to reveal what’s next. [/p][p]
