notes.title: The Absa Update - Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Absa Character Release[/h2][p]The Storm Architect is finally here! Today’s patch welcomes a classic returning character to the Rivals II roster with THUNDEROUS applause. Absa is available for FREE to all players and is available now![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="mvlPxjTgEdk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Absa comes with her own progression awards, coin shop rewards, and her own Arcade mode! All of this and more is available now:[/p][list][*][p][b]Progression Rewards[/b]: Abyss Skin, Absa Gazelle Skin, Taunt 2 / Stomp, Mint Palette, Platform, Death Effect, Emote 1 / Absa in Love,  Emote 2 / Absa Evil, 3D portrait icon, Stock icon, Definitive icon, Bronze icon, Silver icon, Golden icon, Platinum icon[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coin Shop Rewards[/b]: Boer Goat, Black Palette[/p][/*][*][p][b]Absa Arcade Mode[/b]: Abyss Palette, Break the Targets, Splash Art[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/2b2477e7fbb6472145c782b1ad1aea482b5e6686.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/899ca37fae8f3eda53315568b938aa4990649825.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d72a85bac0c09bab2808177f4944f128b9cdfc89.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Absa 101[/h2][p]
Interested in learning Absa? The brand new Absa 101 teaches you all of the basics with legendary Rivals 1 Absa main, Akashi, breaking down her moveset and mechanics![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ybfFMVc6i88;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Pool Party Event[/h2][p]
Summer is here and boy is it HOT. It’s time to cool off with a pool party! Our July event has Pool Party Loxodont, Clairen, and Absa as featured skins with some splashing icons to match. Pool Party Absa has custom taunt and victory lines, and Pool Party Clairen has a custom victory line! The new cosmetics are paired with 25,000 Aether Coins and 250 Aether Bucks.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="R5DMXMuUn40;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Our free track for June contains the Pool Party Absa emote, the Pool Party death effect, Pool Party platform, Otter Maypul icon, and the Pool Party Ranno skin. Players equipping any event skins above, or the Pool Party Fleet skin will receive 20% Bonus XP on the event track. There’s also a brand new Pink Pool Party Fleet palette in the in-game shop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/bfa491ed2eecdcc6ea81efd5c6cfb204344ff9be.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]New Shop Items[/h2][p]In addition to the above, we’re adding two new palettes, and nine new player icons to the buck and coin shop with this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Olympia Yellow Palette[/p][/*][*][p]Pool Party Fleet Pink palette[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/75dd45d45af442a829e3deb8d736d3628a533b5b.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fireworks DFX (Promo this for Fourth of July, also mention in patch notes as a new standalone DFX.)[/p][/*][*][p]Pixel Absa icon[/p][/*][*][p]Tear of Joy icon[/p][/*][*][p]Tear of Anger icon[/p][/*][*][p]Tear of Sorrow icon[/p][/*][*][p]Marinas icon[/p][/*][*][p]Polokai icon[/p][/*][*][p]Floodmingo icon[/p][/*][*][p]Serpensaur icon[/p][/*][*][p]Summer Time icon[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/f3b88782a9c95d180d26a2284f34560e6c147d5f.png"][/img][/p][h2]Summer Palettes & 4th of July Bundle[/h2][p]We’re bringing back a seasonal favorite from the original Rivals of Aether! Summer palettes are here for every Rival as a special release similar to the Halloween palettes we released in 2024. Check em out:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6b7d4fb8d1ed0d14ba93d029c18ba5e95ca3c456.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/94fd8d967c123e272399ceb8ef9f60a5aa538f5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/03be2d951b5800589b69b602271e697040b389bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These palettes are available in the Coin and Buck shop like normal, but are also available with the new Fireworks DFX in our 4th of July Bundle![/p][p][/p][h2]Ranked Shop Update[/h2][p]Champion Maypul has been added to the Ranked Shop! This includes a skin, two emotes, and two icons for the Sylvan Watcher.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/82e73267c19999dc7e89e284eef7b126bcc793bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Ranked Version 2 Season Rollover[/h2][p]Ranked mode has been given a soft reset once again! Any accrued rank-up-bonus medals will be granted to players and a UI element has been added to show off your past season ranks and to view previous ranked season leaderboards![/p][p][/p][h2]Replay Camera Update [/h2][p]Quality of life updates have been made to the replay camera, check it out in your next replay![/p][p][/p][h2]GC Controller Adapter Setup [/h2][p]We have added a new process to make GC controller support functional and easier for players getting into the game! If you’ve been holding off on using your trusty GC controller, or are just joining us with the new update, be sure to give it a try.[/p][p]Usage:[/p][list][*][p]If your adapter brand has a "PC/Console" switch, please ensure it is in "Console" mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Plug your adapter before attempting to move past title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Click or press a key on title screen and the setup popup should appear, then follow on-screen instructions.[/p][/*][/list][p]Notice: If you have already setup your adapter before with the Zadig program, then your adapter does not need any additional setup and the popup will not appear.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/1ec4b1eec76d51e39df711e6aa7a86fe9dd41fa6.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Balance[/h2][p]There are very few balance changes with Absa’s release, keeping in line with our goal to keep big patches a bit more spread out. Most of the changes listed are adjustments made following the big changes from our June mid-month patch, while some are specifically made to work with new quirks that Absa’s release adds to the engine.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6fd9f9202f25816abe013a2383ac93093237b78f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hitting a ceiling while performing a special will no longer end your vertical momentum.[/p][list][*][p]This means that Kragg rock will no longer stop recovery moves in place when they collide with it before breaking it.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Environmental Collision Box (ECB) bottom will be unfrozen when starting a double jump.[/p][list][*][p]This only affects Absa, since her double jump starts by going downward.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused Spot Dodge to slide further than intended when used with high velocity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix: [/b]Fixed a bug that allowed characters to slip off a ledge 1 frame after grabbing an opponent, canceling the grab.[/p][/*][*][p]Baseball Clairen the tipper hit sounds have been remade.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Up Special rising hitbox moved upward halfway between the old and new values.[/p][list][*][p]After last patch's reduction to the disjoint of this move, it became a bit too susceptible to lingering hitboxes offstage, so we're partially reverting this change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/0d3c62f8c7d9f5d3289603c61f20645fe6ffe841.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Slipstream's speed boost will now last for 20 frames after leaving the slipstream.[/p][list][*][p]With the newly shortened slipstream duration, the boost would often disappear suddenly mid-attack. This was especially detrimental to Wrastor's Down Special, which is much slower outside of slipstream. This change gives Wrastor a little more leniency in maintaining his slipstream boost.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Forward Tilt innermost hitbox radius increased by 15 cm, then moved forward and downward.[/p][list][*][p]This makes it reach lower so that it can more consistently hit short characters at point-blank range.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7dd14ccb8acd3afd8f6b31257553bb3d9213766.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Pillar can now only be broken by players whose current and previous ECB bottom locations are below it.[/p][list][*][p]Previously, it only checked the current ECB bottom, which could lead to some weird teleportation bugs when a character hit the pillar immediately after leaving it. This was most common with Absa's Up Special during testing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Down Throw recovery: 17 > 15[/p][/*][*][p]Down Throw knockback: 6.5 + 0.25 @ 65 > 6.9 + 0.25 @ 60[/p][list][*][p]We're partially reverting the endlag increase from the last patch, while changing the knockback to be more dynamic at low percents.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Down Strong hit 1 knockback: 4 + 0 @ 45 > 5 + 0 @ 55[/p][list][*][p]With last patch's removal of early knockback gravity easing, opponents hit by this move would be able to shield the 2nd hit just by DIing away from Olympia. This counterplay made the move too unreliable, so we're making it send slightly higher to keep the opponents off the ground for longer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
Thank you so much for reading, and as always please give us your ideas and feedback! We have a [url="https://rivals-of-aether-ii-patch-130-feedback.nolt.io/"]brand new Nolt Board[/url] with today’s patch, so head on over and let us know what you’re thinking.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.5 Notes - June Mid Month Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Bundle: Baker Olympia[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="3MYSKnPJQkc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Olympia is baking up sweet treats in our latest bundle that includes the Baker Olympia skin, emote, icon, platform, plus 25,000 coins and 250 Aether bucks. This Epic level skin also features brand new custom themed sound effects, visual effects, and victory voicelines![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/5e6b8a33c14b8c5436c34319ebd61d3cd84b848c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Live Events: "GOML: Forever - Canadian Fighting Game Championships" is up next![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/03f55b2b5880d2a866b8e955320043e590b7db18.png"][/img][/p][p]Fresh off CEO 2025 this last weekend, we have our eyes fixed on the next big LAN event of the Rivals 2 Championship Series! [u][url="https://www.start.gg/tournament/get-on-my-level-forever-canadian-fighting-game-championships/details"]GOML: Forever[/url][/u] takes Rivals II to Toronto, Canada with some of the biggest names in Rivals looking to duke it out for the crown.   [/p][p][/p][p]This patch, we're introducing a new sports-themed skin to go with our other loosely "esports skins" that normally get palettes. Introducing Baseball Clairen! Rep the event and show your support with the brand new GOML: Forever themed palette for the all-new skin. This skin includes custom sound effects.  Keep an eye out for this skin to make its return with another palette later in July. [/p][p]
[b]Special Note:[/b] This palette is FREE for all players attending GOML: Forever and [i]sports[/i] custom SFX along with all “E-Sport” skins gaining a cheer SFX in their intro. Attendees will have the skin emailed to them after registration closes.  [/p][p][/p][p]You can still [url="https://www.start.gg/tournament/get-on-my-level-forever-canadian-fighting-game-championships/details"]register for GOML until June 24th[/url], and if your curious how the first ever R2CS season is shaping up, you can check out upcoming & past events and the North American (European coming soon!) leaderboard on our [url="https://www.start.gg/league/rivals-2-championship-series/details"]official league page[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Feature: Practice While in Queue[/b][/h2][p]New to this patch is a long requested feature from players! Now you can enter a solo training room while waiting in an online queue. Simply select "enter training" while actively searching for a match to get the pre-game hand warmers rolling early.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Animations for the Whole Cast[/b][/h2][p]We have a series of new animations for each Rival! [/p][p][/p][p]We encourage players to read through what they can and give us your feedback on our [url="https://rivals-of-aether-ii-patch-125.nolt.io/"]new Nolt Board[/url] after trying them out![/p][list][*][p]Tumble threshold: 27 > 26[/p][list][*][p]This means that attacks will start knocking down slightly earlier, making floorhugging less effective across the board.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Floorhugging no longer requires a timed input.[/p][list][*][p]One of our design philosophies is to make difficult options more accessible, while adding depth in their use cases. Having a timed press requirement meant that a lot of players were unable to use floorhugging, even at higher levels due to the speed of attacks and lower hitpause. We want to ensure that this mechanic is accessible while also focusing on making other options in the game quick and strong instead of constantly toning them down. We have decided to remove the timed input in order to make using floorhugging more accessible and to be able to strengthen other options into the game. We have also added several new counterplay options to encourage a greater risk/reward now that the action is easier to perform. strong qualities that aren't usually present on heavies, such as his high air speed and good recovery tools. We're toning these aspects down so that his weaknesses balance out his strengths better. We're increasing the damage on some of his heavier-hitting moves to help lean into his strengths more.[/p][list][*][p]Max jump horizontal speed: 15 > 12.5[/p][/*][*][p]Max double jump horizontal speed: 13.5 > 12.5[/p][/*][*][p]Air acceleration: 0.85 > 0.75[/p][list][*][p]Kragg's vertical speed is among the fastest in the game, and when combined with his size, his horizontal speed allowed him to quickly control an extremely wide area of the stage. This change aims to make him feel a little more like the heavy character he is, while toning down his horizontal threat ranges.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Leg and waist hurtbox radius expanded slightly.[/p][list][*][p]His thin leg hurtboxes could often make attacks whiff in unexpected situations, considering his otherwise large hurtboxes, so we're making them a bit thicker to make hitting him more consistent.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Up Tilt startup: 7 > 9[/p][/*][*][p]Up Tilt hit 1 active frames: 2 > 1[/p][/*][*][p]Up Tilt hit 2 hitboxes shrunk horizontally.[/p][list][*][p]This move was too strong in a lot of ways, so we're making it a little bit smaller and slower to start up to increase the risk and precision of its use cases.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Down Strong sweetspot damage: 11 > 14[/p][/*][*][p]Down Strong sourspot damage: 10 > 12[/p][/*][*][p]Forward Air sweetspot damage: 11 > 12[/p][/*][*][p]Up Air sweetspot damage: 11 > 12[/p][/*][*][p]Down Air damage: 11 > 12[/p][list][*][p]We're increasing the damage on these moves to make sure Kragg can still output high damage even with the jump speed reduction.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Neutral Air hit 3 knockback: 7 + 0.3 @ 80 > 5.8 + 0.55 @ 75[/p][list][*][p]We're increasing the scaling on this move to make it more unique across percents.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Down Throw recovery: 13 > 17[/p][list][*][p]The follow-ups out of Down Throw were a bit too consistent for our liking, making this throw the go-to throw in almost every situation. It's still a very quick throw, but this should help make the follow-ups afterward more difficult to land.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rock will now be pushed away from players when landing instead of pushing players out of the way.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/75dae4161d00c91e0abc8d6daa9fce66ac839b0c.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Walljump vertical speed: 20 > 22[/p][list][*][p]This increases her overall walljump height gain from 222cm to 268cm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6ca77c1db1b870ae3d6ae4c094c4735d510fbcd1.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Walljump vertical speed: 32.5 > 31[/p][list][*][p]This reduces her overall walljump height gain from 357cm to 325cm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d9d26451786f5c56a31f634b4925dfb3551403a3.png"][/img][/p][p]We have a couple of changes to Loxodont’s Forward Throw in preparation for Absa’s arrival. These changes ensure that she, and other characters will properly be struck by the correct hitboxes during the swing action.[/p][list][*][p]Forward Throw now does a more complex trajectory calculation to determine when to swing the axe.[/p][/*][*][p]Forward Throw initial toss hitstun multiplier: 1.2 > 1.5[/p][list][*][p]These changes are being made in preparation for Absa's release, since her floaty knockback stats made this throw whiff completely against her.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Forward Throw center hitbox now has lower priority than the sweetspot[/p][list][*][p]This fixes a bug where Kragg would still get hit by the sourspot even when he DI'd the initial toss forward.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/9f39c5bd5061caa1c4e3f06e0739027a7e68dba7.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Walljump vertical speed: 28.7 > 26.7[/p][list][*][p]This reduces his overall walljump height gain from 324cm to 281cm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/23dc9abcf3c0ec54b2a05561690db80b97d24479.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Walljump vertical speed: 30.2 > 27.2[/p][list][*][p]This reduces his overall walljump height gain from 353cm to 287cm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/52adfc60212a20bdfb8ae15863b63498fc85bc17.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Walljump vertical speed: 25.66 > 28[/p][list][*][p]This increases his overall walljump height gain from 224cm to 265cm.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]QoL:[/b] Up Air can no longer land during the throw windows.[/p][list][*][p]This prevents the throw from being canceled when Etalus grabs someone while he's right above the ground.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused her Back Air hitboxes to not interpolate when switching from the early hit to the late hit.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These are some big changes that we're sure people will have opinions on, and we encourage that! Our [url="https://rivals-of-aether-ii-patch-125.nolt.io/"]new Nolt Board[/url] is live and ready for feedback. We hope you enjoy this patch, and are looking forward to Absa's release in just 2 weeks![/p]

notes.title: Next Rival Revealed - Absa
notes.content:
Just yesterday at [url=https://combobreaker.org]Combo Breaker 2025[/url] we revealed Absa as the next playable character for Rivals II! See the first look here in her official reveal trailer:

[previewyoutube=mvlPxjTgEdk;full][/previewyoutube]

Absa joins the roster this summer in our third FREE character update. Mark your calendars for the Storm Architect to return on July 1st.

[h1]Introducing Absa's Voice Actress[/h1]

Mae Claire brings the storm!  Please join us in welcoming Mae as the voice of Absa in Rivals 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/26fb75ebfcca635b7637d2fbf0ddec7e57fcaf69.png[/img]

[h1]Rival Backstory[/h1]
[i]Learn more about Absa's past:[/i]

A brilliant mind who embodies both the calm before the storm and all of its fury.

Absa was a little girl when the avian members of the Air Alliance splintered off to form the militant Air Armada. The Air Elders of the Archai Mountains taught detachment and nonaggression, keeping their people to the mountaintops. Absa, being a prodigy, developed the storm-summoning techniques that now enshroud Tempest Peak and protect the Air Alliance from all aggressors below.

However, Absa secretly developed a version for personal use against the wishes of the Air Elders. She felt a dark presence lingering beneath the mountain. While powerful, she knew she would be no match for it, and she did not trust the idle Air Elders to act upon it.

She then left the safety of Tempest Peak and the guidance of the Elders to seek out a new master - one who would open her eyes to new martial forms and more options to protect her homeland. But while Aether looked very small and manageable from on high, she will learn it’s a much bigger and more dangerous world than she imagined.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/30090ac7ba9b2ad306dc2560233dd0ad4fe8a38d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/5a843d9edd8755e222dbc5731e44e24931dfed82.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/961b96bf2926c4e72d91ec2933cdf4f7a29b4817.png[/img]

Keep up to date with more early looks at Absa before her release by [url=https://linktr.ee/studiosofaether]following us on your preferred social media channels here[/url].

notes.title: Hotfix Patchnotes 1.2.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]GENERAL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Babydash cooldown is now reapplied if you try to perform a babydash while it's on cooldown.
[*] Babydash cooldown is now reapplied if you perform a dash dance while the cooldown is already active.
[list]
[*] These changes prevent certain control schemes from bypassing the babydash cooldown, while keeping the functionality unchanged in most normal situations
[/list]
[*] Babydash cooldown is now applied if you perform a backwards dash out of a pivot (i.e. Dash right, press left for 1 frame, then press right again to start a new dash)
[list]
[*] This action allowed players bypass the new 7 frame babydash cooldown without even starting a dash in the opposite direction
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]
MAYPUL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wrapped opponents will now have their ECB bottom frozen
[list]
[*] The addition of dynamic ECBs made it impossible to floorhug while wrapped, so we're fixing that by treating the ECB as grounded.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Dandelion Zetterburn | May Mid-Month Bundle[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Vyz_--TepSI;full][/previewyoutube]

See the Fire's Roar get flowery with the latest bundle that includes the Dandelion Zetterburn skin, emote, icon, and the Dandypoof Death Effect. Bundle also includes 25,000 coins and 250 Aether bucks. This Epic level skin also features brand new custom themed SFX and VFX, including a custom sound for Flame Puddle, custom Fiery Grass hits, and a custom win jingle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/2be44447b9c766a5a35504f7de222a3a6a17789a.png[/img]

[h2]Tune into Combo Breaker 2025 This Weekend[/h2]

The first LAN event of the Rivals 2 Championship Series is this weekend! Top talent featuring CakeAssault, Stango, BioBirb, and many more are competing for the crown in a massive 256 entrant event. The event will be playing on the previous patch, so today’s changes won’t affect competition last minute - remember, you can opt into the previous patch through Steam Betas if you want to get some last minute practice on 1.2.2.2.

Check out the schedule below and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/juicygamenight]catch the stream HERE.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/81075b07b817789ca7343657f1c9690597619f59.jpg[/img]

[h2]Player Feedback Survey[/h2]

We’ve been listening to the playerbase diligently since the launch of Rivals II through Discord, Nolt boards, Reddit, Steam Forums, Blue Sky, X, YouTube, in person, and pretty much ANYWHERE else we could. 

Today we’re launching an in-depth player survey geared towards some more specific feedback from our community, and we need your help to get some answers! To access the survey and help shape the future of Rivals of Aether II, simply click the below image OR launch the game and select the survey in our main menu news section.

[url=https://forms.gle/QoFrQqxkSZWqwv6j7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/8cc0ef555dba512ad10860feb541b86a869d8b73.png[/img][/url]

[h2]New Shop Items[/h2]

We’re adding three new palettes and seven new player icons to the shop this patch. These are a mix of common palettes and rare icons you can grab with coins or bucks:
[list]
[*]Purple Goliath Kragg palette
[*]Mint Cow Loxodont palette
[*]Yellow Cupid Fleet palette
[*]Birder Terry icon
[*]Springbound Zetterburn Icon
[*]Avatar icon Line - Avatar icons for Orcane, Zetterburn, Kragg, Wrastor, Zolt, and Pluffel from Creatures of Aether
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/e0dd8fc7ca9e124e9f9f576399cbf705b66de740.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/7c47e77c04b572e974cf9da060d5106aada1ffd4.png[/img]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We don’t have a lot of balance changes for our mid-month patch, but we do have a few general changes, as well as a few bug fixes and quality of life adjustments.

Note: We will now be specifying quality-of-life (QOL) changes in the patch notes to make it clearer to understand when a change is targeting balance. QOL changes improve the game feel or consistency of a character's options with minimal balance implications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6fd9f9202f25816abe013a2383ac93093237b78f.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Babydashing now has a 7 frame cooldown between uses. This cooldown shouldn’t affect gameplay from normal human inputs, we’re just adding this to prevent exploits possible with controller assisted methods.
[list]
[*]Certain controllers or control schemes were able to easily chain multiple babydashes one after the other in rapid succession, trivializing the difficulty of this extremely powerful technique.
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] The inner ledge grab will now automatically change shape with the character's environmental collision box (ECB).
[list]
[*]This prevents some situations where a character would grab a ledge earlier than intended due to ECB shifting.
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented patch 1.2.2's "Opponents that get spiked into the ground without going into tumble will now only get the full hitstun duration if they land within a few frames after being spiked" change from applying, causing opponents to always get the full hitstun duration.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Up Air hit 2's lowest hitbox reverted to being a sourspot again.
[list]
[*]Removing the sourspot made certain setups a little too consistent, while also removing some of the skill expression that the sweet and sour spots could offer, so we're essentially reverting the change. The middle hitbox is still a sweetspot, but it has the lowest priority of the hitboxes, so the move will function almost identically to the pre-1.2.2 version aside from some rare edge cases where both the foot and hip hitboxes barely whiff.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/52adfc60212a20bdfb8ae15863b63498fc85bc17.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]QOL:[/b] Jab 2 speed boost now occurs 1 frame earlier.
[list]
[*]This makes the speed boost consistent when performing a tilt boost, regardless of which frame of jab 2's startup you cancel.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Gem Field will no longer break projectiles that hit it after it has been deployed.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

We’re aware of a hard to trace issue with some of Olympia’s palettes and other assorted palettes causing immediate disconnects for players when trying to start games with them equipped. We wanted to let affected players know that we’re working hard to determine the issue and patch in a fix. 

As always, please report any bugs or contact our support team over in our official discord for any issues you’re running into: [url=https://discord.gg/RoA]https://discord.gg/RoA[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 1.2.2.2
notes.content:
We've pushed a few small hotfixes since May 6th to this patch primarily focused on performance and menus. Those changes are collectively as followed:

[list]
[*]Miscellaneous localization UI tweaks.
[*]Etalus HUD offset fixes.
[*]Extra players no longer show up briefly in match results.
[*]Fixed a crash when tabbing out in Training Mode.
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent inputs from being processed after quitting out of a replay.
[*]Fixed purple husky Fleet's empowered bow color
[*]The Frame Advance button was added back to the Replay pause menu (1.2.2.1).
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed Maypul to cancel a failed pummel into an Up Special (1.2.2.1).
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Olympia from performing Gem Dash if the Special input was buffered more than 2 frames ago with a neutral joystick (1.2.2.1).
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed Olympia to cancel a failed pummel into a Neutral Special (1.2.2.1).
[/list]
We have a few character specific changes for today's Hotfix Patch 1.2.2.2:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual bug when spawning bubble with Down Special.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6ca77c1db1b870ae3d6ae4c094c4735d510fbcd1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Wall cling will now be consumed if it is interrupted by any attack after 5 frames of clinging.
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Holding your joystick toward the wall while using Tap Walljump will no longer initiate a walljump if your wall cling resource has been consumed.
[*]Non-Special attacks that can cancel into Tether can now only do so in the first 3 frames.
[list]
[*]This prevents accidental tethers, especially when using the alternate Special+Grab and Special+Strong inputs. Previously, attacks could cancel into Tether a maximum of 8 frames into their startup window.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Neutral Special's gem projectile will now go into the Broken state when trading with another projectile instead of being instantly destroyed.
[list]
[*]This bug allowed Olympia to throw another projectile instantly.
[/list]
[*]Non-Special attacks that can cancel into Gem Dash can now only do so in the first 3 frames.
[list]
[*]This prevents accidental Gem Dashes, especially when using the alternate Special+Grab and Special+Strong inputs. Previously, attacks could cancel into Gem Dash a maximum of 11 frames into their startup window.
[/list]
[/list]

This palette is FREE for all players attending Combo Breaker. 

[h3]Ranked Shop Update[/h3]

Champion Wrastor has been added to the Ranked Shop! This includes a skin, two emotes, and two icons for everyone’s favorite bird.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/007a8f130674aa6fd9d77987058187bbacd6df7d.png[/img]
[h3]Lobbies and UI[/h3]

We’ve got a bunch of lobby updates and improvements in this patch for players to help things run a bit more smoothly.
[list]
[*]Training Mode Menu has been updated with Input Recording and Playback!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/0ed6f2f4810920ece1c7461f2ffbd13a5a856ca9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/ace14316222ffa13786dccba5782ac1575564304.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Rock, Paper, Scissors screen has been completely revamped!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/82893b7637a921554a4b2c7319efd843e6d146d7.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The stage striking UI has been updated!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/9ff17620a74802a5f5a8f58e0df034250c66a0a6.png[/img]
[list]
[*]The Pause menu has been given a brand new look!
[*]The critical Hit effect has been given a visual upgrade.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/14119bf64a3ffb92c20b42d6054591e9cdd8b1b6.png[/img]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*]Localization has been added for the following languages: German, Spanish (LATAM), Spanish (ES), Portuguese (Brazilian), Japanese, French.
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
This time around we've got a hefty amount of changes coming to the game, so let's dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6fd9f9202f25816abe013a2383ac93093237b78f.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Buffered attack inputs will now remember your joystick position on the frame that they were pressed.
[list]
[*]Previously, if you input an Up Special but then tilted your joystick sideways before the Up Special started, you would get a Forward Special instead. Now, you will get an Up Special. This does not apply to tilt cancels. Strong Attacks performed with the Strong button will use the joystick position 2 frames after the button is pressed, to reflect the recent change that allows you to change your Forward Strong into an Up/Down Strong within 2 frames of starting it.
[/list]
[*]Hitting an article will now deal half the normal hitpause.
[list]
[*]This makes it less punishing to attack articles, such as Ranno Bubble and Forsburn Clone, and reduces the duration of lingering hitboxes due to hitpause. This does not apply to Kragg's rock and pillar, since they have custom hitpause already.
[/list]
[*]Opponents that get spiked into the ground without going into tumble will now only get the full hitstun duration if they land within a few frames after being spiked. Landing after this window will act like a normal hitstun landing, capping your hitstun to 8 frames.
[list]
[*]The duration of this window depends on the character's fallspeed (with fastfallers having a shorter window and floaty characters having a longer window). This reduces the followups after landing non-tumble spikes high above the ground, while keeping low spikes powerful.
[/list]
[*]A character’s shield hurtbox will no longer be active during the ShieldStart state.
[list]
[*]Shield hurtboxes being active on frame 1 of shielding made some grabs connect in situations that looked like they should whiff, since the shield was not yet visible.
[/list]
[*]The large circular hurtbox will no longer appear during the projectile parry window.
[list]
[*]This hurtbox could still be hit by non-projectile attacks, so it could expand your hurtbox and make you get hit by something that would otherwise whiff.
[/list]
[*]Armoring through an attack will now restore your walljump.
[list]
[*]This mostly benefits Etalus, who can now walljump after using Forward Air to armor an attack.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause certain projectiles to be destroyed by other projectiles in situations where they normally wouldn't.
[list]
[*]This affected projectiles that normally can't be hit at all, like Maypul's Down Air Root.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/bf59dd6daa97eb4e6f6e1ade8bd25c780cbea319.png[/img]
Zetterburn's Forward Air is having its sweetspot size adjusted to make spacing the move a little more difficult. We're also increasing the utility of his fireball in neutral, since it has been fairly lackluster since the recent universal projectile parry buff.
[list]
[*]Forward Special projectile speed: 25 > 30
[list]
[*]This move lacked a bit of utility in neutral after the projectile parry change, as it could now be done on reaction much more reliably. Speeding it up won't push it into unreactable territory, but it will tighten the timing a bit and create some situations where fireball can be more useful than before. This also means the fireball will hit opponents quicker, giving Zetterburn less time to follow up, depending on the spacing.
[/list]
[*]Forward Air's sweetspot shrunk slightly and moved forward to retain the previous forward range.
[list]
[*]This makes the sweetspot spacing slightly tighter in certain scenarios. This should also result in slightly less reverse hits.
[/list]
[*]Up Air sourspot knockback angle: 65 > 60
[list]
[*]This makes DI away more effective at escaping weak Up Air combos.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png[/img]
Ranno has a few moves that threaten a bit more range in neutral than we would like. To address this, we're slightly decreasing the forward range of both fully charged darts and DACUS. We're also making his Up Air's 2nd hit more consistent and giving him a few other quality-of-life changes on some frustrating interactions.
[list]
[*]Time between Forward Tilt hits: 3 frames > 2 frames
[list]
[*]This prevents opponents from floorhugging hit 1 and then shielding hit 2.
[/list]
[*]Ranno will now lose all of his Neutral Special charges when he gets parried.
[list]
[*]This is how charges functioned in Rivals 1, giving the opponent more reward for parrying him.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Special poison dart angle change with charge: 10 > 7 degrees
[list]
[*]This means the 4th dart will now go at a similar angle to the previous 3rd dart, reducing the horizontal range of aerial Neutral Special.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Special can now be canceled with the Parry button if your Air Parry Setting is set to Neutral Air.
[list]
[*]This makes it function how it did before the cancel input changes a few patches ago.
[/list]
[*]Up Special divekick ground friction: 1.2 > 1.0
[list]
[*]This increases the distance he slides by around 9cm, making it slightly more lenient to ledge cancel.
[/list]
[*]DACUS speed multiplier: 0.9 > 0.8
[list]
[*]This reduces the distance of his DACUS by approximately 50cm.
[/list]
[*]Up Air hit 2 no longer has a sourspot.
[list]
[*]This move is too inconsistent when linking into the 2nd hit to make effective use of the sweetspot and sourspot, so we're making hit 2 have the same knockback for all hitboxes.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7dd14ccb8acd3afd8f6b31257553bb3d9213766.png[/img]
Kragg is getting a few changes to the speed of a few of his moves. His Forward Special cancel will now take a few extra frames before the burst action can happen, and his Forward Tilt will now take a few extra frames to act out of.
[list]
[*]Forward Special can now only be canceled after 5 frames.
[list]
[*]This delays the burst movement of this move slightly, while still being bufferable, to give opponents a bit more time to intercept it.
[/list]
[*]Forward Tilt recovery: 18 > 20
[list]
[*]Because this move can be used after hitting a Dash Attack and it covers a wide area, we're adding some recovery to reduce its combo potential.
[/list]
[*]Rock can now only be hit once.
[list]
[*]This clears up some confusion that occurs when two players both hit the rock.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/75dae4161d00c91e0abc8d6daa9fce66ac839b0c.png[/img]
Fleet is getting some love to her Jab combos and a bug fix to her Ledge Special intangibility.
[list]
[*]Jab 1 knockback angle: 45 > 50
[*]Jab 2 knockback angle: 50 > 55
[list]
[*]Because Fleet does not move forward with her jabs, opponents could often fall out of the jab combo because it sent them too far forward. These higher knockback angles will keep opponents closer to Fleet.
[/list]
[*]Ledge Special intangibility normalized between Back, Up, and Forward windows. The intangibility now ends on the first active frame for all 3 windows.
[list]
[*]Previously, the Up and Forward versions were bugged and kept their intangibility all the way until the recovery frames, while the Back version ended before the active frames. Now they all last until the active frames, allowing Fleet to trade with active moves consistently.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6ca77c1db1b870ae3d6ae4c094c4735d510fbcd1.png[/img]
Overall, Maypul's recovery has been less of a weakness than intended, since her options once reaching the wall are very strong. We're limiting her to one wall cling per airtime, as well as making small changes to her Up Special and Up Air. We also are switching up her tether target priority so that she doesn't end up in a bad situation in doubles.
[list]
[*]Up Special max horizontal air speed: 17 > 13
[list]
[*]This reduces the distance Maypul can cover when drifting after Up Special.
[/list]
[*]Up Special's ledge grab box now gets much shorter after entering the Special Fall window.
[list]
[*]This does not affect her ledge grab box at the peak of the Up Special, but reduces the disjoint of her ledge grab after she falls for a bit.
[/list]
[*]Up Special hit 2 hitboxes shrunk slightly.
[list]
[*]We're reducing the horizontal range so that it doesn't clip opponents at ledge as easily, while preserving the vertical range so it can still be used in the same situations as a finisher.
[/list]
[*]Maypul can now only wall cling once per airtime.
[list]
[*]The resource is only consumed if she wall clings for more than 5 frames, to prevent her from accidentally spending this resource when attempting a normal walljump. The wall cling is restored on touching ground, grabbing ledge, or hitting an opponent.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Air landing lag: 9 > 8
[list]
[*]This move is supposed to be a very good approach tool, but the landing lag made it a bit difficult to get value out of, especially on shield.
[/list]
[*]Back Air hit 1 damage: 4 > 3
[*]Back Air hit 1 knockback angle: 90 > 85
[*]Back Air hit 1 hitstun multiplier and hitfall hitstun multiplier: 0.8 > 0.9
[list]
[*]This lets her use the first hit of Back Air in more situations, since it was fairly limited before. The new knockback angle gives opponents more agency in avoiding followups.
[/list]
[*]Up Air recovery: 15 > 17
[list]
[*]This move is still a little too overcentralizing to Maypul's kit, both in her punish game and recovery. This small endlag increase aims to increase the counterplay in both scenarios.
[/list]
[*]Tether will now prioritize teammates over enemies not in hitstun.
[list]
[*]Actionable enemies are the most dangerous thing Maypul can tether to, so we're making her tether to the safe option (teammates) if possible.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/80071214314eb0f5d582a31bebfef1823b2efedf.png[/img]
Clairen is getting an air acceleration change to bring her more in line with the rest of the cast and make spacing her tippers more committal. On top of that, we’re increasing the recovery frames and reducing the active frames of her Neutral Air’s final hit and making her Up Special 2 less susceptible to getting punished after hitting opponents.
[list]
[*]Air acceleration: 1.0 > 0.75
[list]
[*]Clairen had the highest air acceleration in the game (excluding Wrastor in slipstream), which allowed her to space her tippers with more leniency than we would like.
[/list]
[*]Up Special air acceleration set to 1.0
[list]
[*]Since her overall air acceleration is being changed, her Up Special felt a bit worse than we would like. This will make her Up Special feel identical to the previous patch.
[/list]
[*]Up Special part 2 sourspot knockback: 6.5 + 0.35 > 8 + 0.35
[list]
[*]This makes Clairen less punishable on hit when landing this move, since the opponent will be pushed further away.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Air recovery: 12 > 15
[list]
[*]This makes it more punishable and reduces the followups slightly when used high in the air.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Air final hit active frames: 4 > 3
[list]
[*]This move was lingering slightly longer than we would like.
[/list]
[*]Ledge Special hit 2 hitbox now reaches more forward.
[list]
[*]Landing a max-range hit 1 could often make hit 2 whiff on characters that get thinner during hitstun (i.e. Ranno and Maypul).
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d9d26451786f5c56a31f634b4925dfb3551403a3.png[/img]
Loxodont is getting a few changes to some of his more brutal Special Attacks that are stronger than intended in the air. These changes should make them act closer to how they appear. We are also reducing the power of his sweeping Forward Air on shield, as it can be pretty difficult to punish.
[list]
[*]Neutral Special fully charged knockback multiplier: 1.3 > 1.15
[list]
[*]Because this attack is very strong uncharged, a 1.3 multiplier made it stronger than we would like, especially when paired with level 3 Down Special. This new multiplier will make sure the reward is still very high while removing the situations where this two-piece combo kills at absurdly low percents. To put it in perspective, it takes Strong Attacks 60 frames to hit a 1.3 multiplier, while it used to take Loxodont Neutral Special 30 frames.
[/list]
[*]Up Special falling hit hitstun multiplier: 1.0 > 0.8
[list]
[*]This move has extremely high base knockback to allow it to link into the landing hit, but this knockback was especially deadly offstage, where opponents would often have no chance of coming back if hit by this large move. This hitstun reduction shouldn't affect it onstage in most cases, but should make recovering against it less of a death sentence.
[/list]
[*]Forward Air sweetspot damage: 10 > 9
[*]Forward Air landing lag: 10 > 11
[list]
[*]This move was too good on shield even when used at point-blank range, when it is intended to require spacing to be safe on shield.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/23dc9abcf3c0ec54b2a05561690db80b97d24479.png[/img]
While Forsburn is pretty solid balance-wise, many Forsburn mains have expressed that his playstyle has become somewhat stale, with too much emphasis on his normal attacks and little reason to use his deception tools. To remedy this, we're shifting his power around to make him more unique and interesting to play. We're also giving some love to his Up Throw, since his low-percent throw game was a little more straightforward than it could be.
[list]
[*]Forward Special recovery: 7 > 4
[list]
[*]In a previous patch, this move's recovery was increased from 3 to 7 to tone down his mixups when spawning clone in neutral, specifically when used after a fullhop to descend with Back/Down Air. Since those aerials have since been toned down, we're almost fully reverting the change to give Forsburn more chances to spawn a clone in neutral.
[/list]
[*]Forward Tilt recovery: 16 > 17
[*]Up Tilt recovery: 15 > 17
[list]
[*]We're toning down these extremely fast tilts both on hit and on shield.
[/list]
[*]Up Tilt knockback: 7 + 0.55 > 7 + 0.7
[list]
[*]The extra scaling makes his Up Tilt Strong attack loops end earlier.
[/list]
[*]Back Air landing lag: 11 > 12
[*]Back Air sweetspot shield stun: 9 > 8
[list]
[*]This makes shielding Back Air more effective as counterplay.
[/list]
[*]Up Throw recovery: 33 > 31
[*]Up Throw knockback: 9 + 0.5 > 10 + 0.5
[list]
[*]This makes it more rewarding at low percents, so that his best option after grabbing the opponent isn't always Down Throw into tech chase.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/52adfc60212a20bdfb8ae15863b63498fc85bc17.jpg[/img]
Etalus is getting a quality-of-life change to his Forward Special as well as some love to his Forward Air to make it useful in more situations and deal more damage. His Up Special is getting a change to its post-launch actionability that was accidentally slower than intended, while also getting a small startup increase and a quality-of-life change to help with misinputs.
[list]
[*]Forward Special icicle hitbox expanded backward.
[list]
[*]This makes it less likely for opponents to slip between the icicles unharmed.
[/list]
[*]Up Special speed threshold for cancels: 22.66 > 32.58
[list]
[*]This makes it match the cancel timing from Rivals 1. It was actually intended to match from the beginning, but was modeled after an outdated version of Rivals 1 instead. This means that Etalus will be able to act sooner after an Up Special releases.
[/list]
[*]Up Special post-charge startup: 2 > 6
[list]
[*]With the faster actionability after launching, he could get an attack out a bit too fast. This change makes the Up Special launch happen on the same frame as in Rivals 1, so the cancel timing is also the same. This also makes the spike hitbox appear 4 frames later, which helps to balance how strong it is both onstage and off.
[/list]
[*]Etalus can now start an Up Special by holding up and special on the IASA frame of any state.
[list]
[*]Because his Up Special is chargeable, he can't mash the special button to get a well-timed Up Special like the rest of the characters. This change allows him to just hold the input instead. This was already possible out of hitstun states, but now it works for any state.
[/list]
[*]Up Special ledge grab box now reaches 10cm higher.
[list]
[*]Because of the variable distance of his recovery, it can be tricky to sweetspot the ledge, especially since he pokes his head relatively high up during his Up Special. We're increasing his ledge grab leniency very slightly to help with this.
[/list]
[*]Down Special shockwave will now freeze players if any part of their ECB is over it, instead of just their center.
[*]Forward Air damage: 11 > 13
[list]
[*]This felt a little weak damage-wise for how strong the knockback is.
[/list]
[*]Forward Air's armor starts 3 frames earlier.
[list]
[*]Forward Air armor is one of his most unique tools, but its high startup made it too difficult to use in situations where it would be useful, so we're shaving some frames from the startup.
[/list]
[*]Back Air innermost hitbox size reduced.
[list]
[*]This reduces the reverse hit range, since this move was overshadowing his other aerials when used after Dash Attack.
[/list]
[*]Down Air landing lag: 10 > 12
[list]
[*]This move is extremely versatile and leads into some of Etalus' strongest punish options. We're increasing the landing lag to tone down the combo potential and make it slightly more punishable on whiff/shield.
[/list]
[*]Opponents can now wall tech immediately after getting grabbed by Etalus' Up Air.
[list]
[*]This gives opponents a chance to survive after Etalus wall techs their attack and instantly hits them with Up Air. The game will check for an active tech window on the first frame after Etalus grabs a player close enough to a wall.
[/list]
[*]Down Throw will no longer remove his ice armor.
[list]
[*]This throw was not strong enough to warrant Etalus losing his armor, so now he gets to keep it while still getting the strength increase on the throw.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png[/img]
Olympia has proved to be fairly strong, with a few aspects being stronger than intended, such as her recovery at top level. To fix this, we're reducing the effectiveness of Down Special Cancel while recovering, while also removing some of the mixup potential of her Up Special. Even though her offense is intended to be her strength, there were a few moves that have proved to be a bit overcentralizing, such as her safe aerials, neutral special setups, and forward special followups. These are all receiving some small tweaks to increase the potential for counterplay while still keeping them strong.
[list]
[*]Neutral Air hit 2 damage: 5 > 4
[*]Neutral Air landing lag: 7 > 8
[list]
[*]This reduces the effectiveness of this move on shield.
[/list]
[*]Forward Air recovery: 18 > 20
[list]
[*]This slightly reduces the potency of her options after ending this move in the air, both on hit and whiff.
[/list]
[*]Forward Air landing lag: 11 > 12
[*]Forward Air early hit damage: 11 > 10
[list]
[*]This reduces the effectiveness of this move on shield, while also making it slightly more punishable on whiff.
[/list]
[*]Up Air recovery: 15 > 18
[*]Up Air early hit damage: 8 > 6
[*]Up Air mid hit damage: 8 > 6
[*]Up Air landing lag: 10 > 11
[list]
[*]This reduces the effectiveness of this move on shield, while also reducing the damage buildup when hitting with it mid-combo.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Special will now have a 30 frame cooldown when the gem field is deployed.
[list]
[*]This prevents Olympia from instantly popping the gem field on hit, which would force the opponent into a scramble situation. It also prevents her from punishing a parry attempt by stopping the projectile early and then instantly popping it.
[/list]
[*]Forward Special slam landing recovery: 12 > 16
[*]Forward Special knockback: 6.5 + 0.7 @ 80 > 6.5 + 0.9 @ 80
[list]
[*]This makes it send opponents farther away at higher percents, which can reduce the potency of onstage followups, but also makes it potentially more powerful when used offstage, since DI out can lead to a direct KO.
[/list]
[*]Up Special can no longer fastfall until the Special Fall window.
[list]
[*]This adds some commitment before you can fastfall to ledge when forced to recover high.
[/list]
[*]Up Special no longer gives a small horizontal boost when holding backward at the beginning of the Recovery window.
[list]
[*]This makes it more risky to use offstage, since she won't be able to drift backward as far.
[/list]
[*]Down Special cancel's speed will now decay with each use until Olympia touches ground or grabs the ledge.
[list]
[*]This makes intercepting Olympia's recovery more rewarding, since she won't get the full Down Special cancel dash back.
[/list]
[*]Getup Special recovery: 29 > 33
[list]
[*]This increases the punish window when this move gets shielded, while also toning down the followups Olympia gets when hitting an opponent with it.
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Getup Special crystals will now deactivate if Olympia is interrupted during the startup.
[/list]
That's it for today! Thank you for reading this far and please be sure to check out our [url=https://rivals-of-aether-ii-patch-122.nolt.io/]new Nolt Board[/url], where community members can leave feedback about the game and help us continue to add helpful features!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1 Notes
notes.content:
Here's what's new in patch 1.2.1:

[h2]Badger Co. Bundle[/h2]

Badger Co. Olympia comes out today in our latest midmonth bundle. This includes the Badger Co. Olympia skin, emote, icon, and the Deconstruction Death Effect (+ coins and bucks). This skin also includes unique voiceover lines for her taunt and victory sequence.

[previewyoutube=rCQwqFb5WRU;full][/previewyoutube]

This skin was originally revealed live during the Twitch Rivals (of Aether II) Team Battle event. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2430248425?t=00h15m30s]Check out the VoD[/url] to catch 4 teams of creators led by Rivals pros battle for the crown. 

[h2]A Little Main Menu UI Update[/h2]

The Main Menu now shows your most recent platform used in tandem with character and skin. This actually snuck into a recent Hotfix but we wanted to make sure it got listed in the official notes too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/7d2650597c745c96751a3cefa2c5b64d5d4b0f78.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay and Balance Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/6fd9f9202f25816abe013a2383ac93093237b78f.png[/img]

We recently added dynamic Environmental Collision Boxes (ECB) to the game, which allows characters to behave more naturally when interacting near objects and the ground. While we initially did a lot of testing, we knew the change was too broad to catch everything off the bat. 

A decent amount of the changes to general mechanics and characters this patch involve corrections related to the ECB changes. Beyond the ECB fixes, we have some changes to chaingrab protection, a few changes related to landing interactions, and a few character updates.
[list]
[*]Chaingrab protection will now last for an extra 5 frames after being disabled, unless you start an attack.
[list]
[*]This allows you to start an action without instantly making yourself vulnerable to chaingrabs. This is especially useful when landing before getting grabbed again, since doing nothing will leave you in the Hitstun Land state longer than if you cancel it into another action (Kragg Down Throw often forces this interaction).
[/list]
[*]You can now land while rising near the peak of your trajectory arc.
[list]
[*]This prevents situations where you could pass through the ground if your Environmental Collision Box (ECB) bottom collided with a platform while you were still rising and then never went above the platform again.
[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause characters to fall through platforms when they end up right above a platform while falling as their ECB gets taller.
[*]ECB bottom can no longer go lower than the character's origin.
[list]
[*]This prevents players from falling through platforms if their ECB bottom unfreezes on a frame where it was below the character's origin.
[/list]
[*]Landing while in non-tumble hitstun will now give a maximum of 8 frames of Hitstun Land.
[list]
[*]This makes it less punishing when landing after weak/medium hits. This does not apply when you are spiked into the ground (i.e. Orcane Dair) and will mostly only affect extremely low angle moves (i.e. Zetterburn Neutral Special or Loxodont Forward Tilt hit 1).
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Non-tumble spikes on aerial opponents will no longer reduce their hitstun by half.
[list]
[*]There were a lot of cases where opponents right above the ground would get spiked into the ground and become actionable before the move they were hit by was finished due to this hitstun reduction. This change makes sure that spikes are better against opponents right above the ground, and will instead give a similar advantage to spiking them while grounded.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/bf59dd6daa97eb4e6f6e1ade8bd25c780cbea319.png[/img]
Zetterburn is getting a quality of life change for Tap Jump controls.
[list]
[*]Neutral Special will now listen for Jump inputs during hitpause.
[list]
[*]Previously, tap jump users had a shorter buffer for jump canceling this move, since joystick hard presses aren't stored for as long in the buffer. This keeps things consistent between control schemes. 
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/32bd068213acedac4908c13fd97b375b6740b0c7.png[/img]
Ranno is getting two changes that allow him to cancel Neutral Special with grab again, and will help him use tongue sling above platforms more consistently.
[list]
[*]Neutral Special can now be canceled by pressing the Grab button again.
[list]
[*]This was unintentionally removed in the 1.2.0.5 hotfix where many attacks that can be canceled by pressing Shield were normalized.
[/list]
[*]Forward Special will now freeze his ECB bottom for the first 10 frames of tongue sling.
[list]
[*]This prevents him from unintentionally canceling the tongue sling by landing on a platform.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d9d26451786f5c56a31f634b4925dfb3551403a3.png[/img]
Loxodont is getting a few changes to his Forward Tilt that make the move function similar to how it did before the universal ECB changes affected landing timings.
[list]
[*]Forward Tilt hit 1 ASDI modifier: 1 > 1.5
[*]Forward Tilt hit 1 knockback angle: 150 > 160
[list]
[*]The addition of dynamic ECBs made some opponents take longer to land after getting hit by this move. This change makes the move function similar to how it did prior to the ECB changes when opponents DI and ASDI down.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/23dc9abcf3c0ec54b2a05561690db80b97d24479.png[/img]
Forsburn is getting a bug fix to his clone’s recovery, which will make it SD less often.
[list]
[*][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Clone will no longer Up Special offstage right before landing on stage after recovering.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/52adfc60212a20bdfb8ae15863b63498fc85bc17.jpg[/img]
Etalus is getting some love to his roll distances and his getup attack to help a bit with his disadvantage state.
[list]
[*]Roll speed: 28 > 32
[*]Tech Roll speed: 29 > 31
[*]Getup Roll speed: 27 > 30
[*]Ledge Roll speed: 26 > 28
[list]
[*]His width made him especially vulnerable to shield pressure and tech chasing. The increased speed will in turn increase the distance of his rolls a bit, making him a little more difficult to stay on top of.
[/list]
[*]Getup Attack's innermost hitbox radius: 40cm > 60cm
[list]
[*]This prevents it from whiffing against small characters at specific spacings
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b7fb1c812dce9b653b7cb646654ecf8a1832c310.png[/img]
Olympia’s release two weeks ago was exciting for us as an influx of new and returning players jumped at the chance to try out the Amethysts Fist! We’ve been monitoring community reception, tournaments, and have been playing a lot of Olympia ourselves with the intention of finding a perfect spot for her balance. 

We feel that she has plenty of power, but don’t want to overswing on changes since she is so new and there’s still a lot to learn both in her meta and in her counterplay. That being said there's a few things we want to hit in this midmonth update:
[list]
[*]Up Special linking hits hitbox radius: 60cm > 50cm
[list]
[*]We're shrinking the hitboxes for this move to require tighter spacing, since it's such a powerful finisher.
[/list]
[*]Neutral Special Gem Toss knockback angle: 90 > 75
[list]
[*]This increases the effectiveness of DI out against this move.
[/list]
[*]Gem Dash startup: 4 > 6
[list]
[*]This attack was an extremely potent followup after Olympia hit with Gem Toss, while also being an extremely strong recovery tool. The increased startup makes it a little harder to combo into while also giving opponents more time to intercept it offstage.
[/list]
[*]Gem Field broken duration: 2 seconds > 3 seconds
[list]
[*]This increases the reward for breaking Olympia's gem field, both on stage and during her recovery.
[/list]
[*]Forward Special intangibility when slamming an opponent: 30 frames > 20 frames
[list]
[*]She gains intangibility here to protect her against opponents that wall tech after getting hit by this move while edgeguarding Olympia. 30 frames ended up being a bit excessive, since Olympia is actionable after only 15, so we're shortening it a bit.
[/list]
[*]Forward Special no longer gets intangibility when slamming an opponent into the ground.
[list]
[*]The intangibility made this attack too difficult to punish in Doubles and Free-For-All.
[/list]
[*]Down Tilt is now auto-floorhuggable.
[list]
[*]The speed of this move made performing a timed floorhug pretty unreliable, when it is generally the best counterplay to the attack.
[/list]
[*]Up Throw knockback: 10.6 + 0.5 > 10.6 + 0.55
[list]
[*]We're increasing the knockback scaling to make it send opponents farther away at high percents.
[/list]
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Neutral Special's projectile will no longer trade with opponents.
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Gem Field can now be hit by hitgrabs (i.e. Etalus Up Air, Wrastor Down Special).
[*][b]Bug fix:[/b] Forward Special will now prevent chaingrabs when slamming an opponent.
[/list]
