notes.title: Developer Update - August 2024
notes.content:
This month we got a bunch of new features in while we wrapped up the summer season of development. Remember as we get closer to the end of the year and our previously announced Q4 launch, updates are going to start coming in hot. Make sure to especially pay attention in September for more news! 

If you haven't been following the project closely, we're currently doing closed betas leading up to launch later this year. Even though the betas are closed we're still sharing dev updates so you can follow along on the project. Here's what we've been working on for August:

[h1]Emotes[/h1]

The emote feature returns from the original Rivals of Aether for our current backer beta. We enjoyed the throwback of using pixel art for these done by Ellian, our longtime animator from Rivals 1.  

The emote system is our one and only approved way to trash talk (and talk to your opponent in general). We've got a bunch of emotes everyone will be able to  to use to start off with, and you can also unlock more emotes to add to your collection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b0e7b81316cf74aa29b84f36657941e155ec4c31.png[/img]
[i]Dan emoting in game next to Dan emoting in Real Life.[/i]

[h1]Palettes[/h1]

We're introducing the palette feature this month, making new colors and looks available for skins. Our first two palettes available to test are black palettes available with beta coins for Clairen and Loxodont. Unlock them in the shop to try them yourself! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/36652de0233dbe946d794cf1049db419a967539b.png[/img]
[i]For just 300 beta coins, two palettes can be yours.[/i]

[h1]Training Mode Updates[/h1]

Training mode got a big level up this beta as we work to flesh it out even more. A brand new menu is now accessible through the pause screen while in training mode with new options like:

[list]
[*]     Set the CPU behavior state (Stand, Shield, etc.).
[*]     You can now set Damage and a DI mode for the CPU.
[*]     Give the CPU tech, getup, and counter options.
[*]     Turn on THE GRID.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/f1903f70c9a6793c40d017ca08eb1b26a4410365.png[/img]
[i]Ah yes, Zetterburn's fireball goes 3 far.[/i]

[h1]V1 of Disconnect/Reconnect Handling[/h1]

We have implemented basic disconnect/reconnect handling this patch. If you crash out of a match or lobby (or simply drop from a bad connection), there's now a special button in the online tab that lets you rejoin. 

We consider this a V1 of the feature as it doesn't pause the ongoing match or anything, but you're able to hop back into your lobby with your friends now instead of having to have everyone leave and make a new lobby. We're looking forward to building on this in the future and hope it makes players lives a bit easier even in this form. 

[h1]Additional Server Support [/h1]

We have new default servers available for South America and Latin America. These servers are located in Lima, Peru, Buenos Aires, Argentina, and Santiago, Chile. We also have Mexico City, Mexico, which will be entirely new for this beta! We've made efforts to add these based on feedback in our nolt board, so let us know if you're in an underrepresented region that could benefit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/bd6c79be6df517664bd314643d94ddcbd86822be.png[/img]

[h1]August Patchnotes[/h1]

The August beta has new patch notes for each character, along with some general engine changes across the board. We've done our best to address hot topics and you can read the full (very verbose) notes in our August Patchnotes Article. Here's some of the highlights for a TL;DR:

[list]
[*]     Loxodont got a bunch of love, including sour spot buffs on his strong attacks plus a brand new way to interact with his boulder using side special. 
[*]     Floorhugging now requires a downward hard press as a way to greatly increase the difficulty. This makes it still useful in the areas we want it to be, while avoiding all of the accidental floorhugs in previous patches that made it so prevalent. 
[*]     Many characters had their hitstun gravity changed to be less extreme and moved closer to the average. This makes it easier to combo floaties, and also should alleviate some complaints about the combo game at low percents. 
[*]     We brought back some mechanics from Rivals 1 like being able to slide while parrying (especially good for dealing with bubbles or Lily) and another that make fastfall platdrop aerials easier.
[/list]

[h1]What's Next - Roadmap Expansion[/h1]

You might have noticed that August was the last month on our roadmap we originally posted when we first started doing these betas all the way back in Spring. Going forward, as we close in on our announced release range of "Q4", we'll be taking things month by month:

[h2]September Beta Details[/h2]

Our September beta will take place on September 27 - 29. This beta will have a new twist, and be the first beta with a limited number of slots available for anyone to join. We'll be sharing more news in September on how you can get on the list for a chance to be chosen to play via the Steam playtest feature. Make sure to wishlist the game if you haven't yet, as we'll also be posting the news here!

[h2]Wrapping Up[/h2]

If you'd like to get involved with the closed beta with guaranteed access immediately, checkout our website for details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/e64c883bdecd171a149e365fd04012d080d81866.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update - July 2024
notes.content:
This month’s dev update features our 9th Rival revealed for the launch roster, more news from Evo 2024, plus an update on what we checked off from our roadmap this month. Read on for details:

[h1]Orcane Revealed[/h1]

In case you missed it, last weekend Aether Studios went to [url=https://www.evo.gg/]Evo 2024[/url] (the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament in the world) where we showed off the latest build of Rivals 2.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/79db7a348b8389d3cb15de2d36e823fe1aa72ae8.png[/img]

We were incredibly excited to have the stage Friday to reveal our 9th Rival in the roster - Orcane! Orcane returns with his slippery and all around adorable gameplay, plus some new tricks like teleporting [i]with[/i] his opponents through his puddle. Check out his reveal trailer if you haven’t yet:

[previewyoutube=Axm9PyIbXtc;full][/previewyoutube]

We also created a moveset breakdown that goes through every one of his attacks for a thorough look at how he plays. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ou_9oCo7fso]Check out that Orcane Moveset Breakdown video here[/url]. 

[h1]All Future Characters Free[/h1]

Our other big Evo announcement was that all future characters in Rivals 2 after launch will be FREE updates to the game. No paid character DLCs or grinding required. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/a9b214ac4ae816d868c9e1a4a68d5a0b2eadb98f.png[/img]

We know the typical lifeblood of a fighting game comes from character releases as the game grows, so our plan is to make them unlocked and playable for everyone as soon as they’re available. As players this is the type of model we’d like to see, and we hope it catches on and works out for everyone. We have [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k3Z-0Pqgeew]plans for tons of characters after launch[/url] and can’t wait to expand the roster. If you want to support us over the long haul we’ll have cosmetics to help sustain the game, but we'll make sure you [i]won’t[/i] be able to buy a competitive edge. 

[h1]July Backer Beta[/h1]
Today is our next Backer Beta, taking place from [i]July 26th at 8am PT - July 28th at 11:59pm PT[/i]. Here’s what’s included in this beta from our roadmap, plus a few bonus items that snuck in:

[list]
[*] [b]Orcane Now Available[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now play as Orcane!. We’d love your feedback on our latest Rival. Help us out by [url=https://discord.gg/RoA]sharing any bugs you find[/url] and as well as [url=https://rivals-2-july-beta-feedback.nolt.io/]giving us your suggestions[/url]!
[/list]
[*] [b]Matchmaking Logic Added[/b]
[list]
[*] This wasn’t on the roadmap, but we were able to add in an early version of matchmaking as a bonus feature  to our 1v1 and Doubles queues with the goal of improving the fairness of the games you’ll find. We know upfront this will need some tweaking, so [url=https://rivals-2-july-beta-feedback.nolt.io/]let us know your feedback[/url] about your matchmaking experience and queue times this weekend.  
[/list]
[*] [b]More Player Inventory Testing[/b]
[list]
[*] Character specific spawn platforms have been added! During this beta all of the base character platforms will be available for testing. Swap them out on any character and [url=https://discord.gg/RoA]let us know if you run into any bugs[/url]. In the future these nine base platforms will be unlockable via character progression.
[/list]
[*] [b]More Beta Coin Shop Items Added[/b]
[list]
You can unlock these with the coins you earn through playing and keep them post-launch! All six items currently in the coin shop will return in August’s backer beta, so don’t fret if you can’t get them all this weekend.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/3211cb33138f3ac8d92b0a5efaf7abee9ab73934.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Region Preferences Added
[list]
[*] You can now set a region preference for where the server will be located in your lobbies. This overrides how the game automatically tries to calculate and choose the best server between all players in your lobby. 
[/list]
[*] Camera Tools
[list]
[*] Another bonus feature going in this beta is our new CAMERA TOOLZ. This is something we’ve been developing behind the scenes to help make our beautiful character reveal trailers, and this month it’s far enough along to let creators play with it. Set up cameras and keyframes in your replays to export amazing footage and bring your visuals to the next level.
[/list]
[url=https://rivals-2-july-beta-feedback.nolt.io/]Let us know what else you’d like to see from this tool[/url]! Please keep in mind the version available during this beta is a very early version. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/17aaf4822e797c1eda93dabe592269a98fe23071.png[/img]


One last thing to add regarding our roadmap - we originally intended to test emotes this month for the first time, but unfortunately this feature is not quite ready. We’ll be delaying this to the August beta. Don’t forget to [url=https://rivals-2-july-beta-feedback.nolt.io/]give us your feedback and suggestions[/url] on all the new changes this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d8fa8019850cf54900d55b0c0d121554bc52f30b.png[/img]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
We’ve got one more beta planned to close out the summer after this one ends. Don’t worry we know that our current roadmap ends in August, so expect more news and an expansion on what to look forward to as we get closer. We hope you all enjoy the latest beta this weekend. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/ee650f81f28b9715c9a429713b886808b489ed4e.png[/img]

If you’re looking for official Rivals events next month make sure to tune in for Rivals 2 at [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/supernova-2024/details]Supernova[/url], and stop by and say “hi” if you’ll be at [url=https://west.paxsite.com/]PAX West[/url] in Seattle!

notes.title: Developer Update - June 2024
notes.content:
As we get closer to release with more news to share, we think it’s about time to start putting out some sizable Steam news updates each month. For those following along, we’re still on track to release the game in Q4 this year, and are looking forward to revealing a release date as we get closer. This month was big for us and we’ve got plenty to share, so time for some dev logs! 

[h1]Kickstarter Beta This Weekend (6/28-6/30)[/h1]
We started doing monthly betas this Spring for our Kickstarter backers, and this weekend is our third one. We’ve been hard at work with this being the most feature heavy update yet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/b4a3423c32fe2710c23379e27081e307ba22a98f.jpg[/img]

There's a TON of new features in this beta including:

[list]
[*] Skins - You can now style on your opponents [i]in style[/i] and customize your look.
[*] Character Progression - Level up your characters by gaining experience as you play matches. Our progression system is completely cosmetic, and as your characters level up, you’ll unlock rewards plus currency like Aether Coins.
[*] Beta Coin Shop - Spend your Aether Coins you earn from playing to unlock a variety of cosmetics for your character. Finally there’s something to do with your Aether Coins instead of hoarding them like Rivals 1!
[*] New Servers - New server technology allows for smarter routing and better connections.
[*] Balance Changes - We’ve made tweaks across the board to try and find the sweet spot for what makes Rivals 2 fun. We want to hear your thoughts so leave us your latest balance feedback and game suggestions on our [url=https://rivals-2-june-beta.nolt.io/]June Suggestions Nolt Board[/url]. 
[/list]

If you’d like to get your hands on the game early in these backer beta rounds, you can still Late Pledge over on our PledgeManager page. Kickstarter betas currently happen one weekend per month.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/18e957d534074d06c33823425dbd3d1dd5bc494e.png[/img]

[h1]Offbrand Co-Publisher Announcement[/h1]
This month also started off with a big announcement that we’re teaming up with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/offbrandgames]Offbrand Games[/url] as our official co-publishing partner on Rivals 2. This partnership brings a lot of exciting opportunities for Rivals 2 players in the future - including more Rivals focused events, content, and eyes on our community! The news was announced on IGN Live with Ludwig, Thor from PirateSoftware, and Dan.

[previewyoutube=ppAAyQ395xc;full][/previewyoutube]

We think Offbrand is a perfect fit for us. They're going to complement our indie studio by letting us focus on making a great game, while they focus on bringing more eyes to our community with marketing and events. We’re incredibly excited for the future and this partnership is a win for everyone who’s a fan of Rivals!  

[h1]What’s Next This Summer[/h1]

[h3]Workshop Contest Winner Reveal[/h3]
Last year we announced a crossover event that spanned both Rivals 1 and Rivals 2 with our new Workshop Character Contest. Creators were asked to submit original characters to our dev team with the winner being chosen to eventually become a character in Rivals 2. 

[previewyoutube=JSbcUYz1OIE;full][/previewyoutube]

We had over 80 submissions of amazingly designed characters, and next week on the one year anniversary of the contest we’ll reveal the winner. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=383980]Check out the characters in the Rivals 1 workshop and try them out yourself![/url] Make sure to keep an eye out for the news on 7/3 to see a preview of a future character in Rivals 2. 

[h3]Summer Events[/h3]
We’ll be at a few events this summer with a playable pre-release build of Rivals 2. Make sure to stop by to chat with us and play the latest build!

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.evo.gg/]Evo 2024[/url] - We’ll have a booth at EVO again this year and are looking forward to sharing some news there on what’s coming for the July backer beta. Stop by and play!

[*] [url=https://west.paxsite.com/]PAX West 2024[/url] - More of the team will be at PAX West since it’s held in the studio’s “home city” of Seattle. We’ll be bringing our some new and old merch so make sure to come by to browse and play. 

[*] [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/riptide-2024-5/details]Riptide 2024[/url] - This 3-day waterpark tournament is a community favorite. We’ll be there with brackets for both Rivals 2 and Rivals 1. Registration is still open so [url=https://www.start.gg/tournament/riptide-2024-5/details]sign up now[/url]. 
[/list]



Thanks for following along with our updates! Look out for another developer update next month with more exciting news as we get closer to launch.

notes.title: Evo 2023 Reveal
notes.content:
Last weekend we were honored and excited to take part in the Evo 2023 announcement showcase. After all, it was attending Evo 2013 ten years ago that originally ignited our passion to create Rivals of Aether. Here's a recap from what Studio Lead Dan Fornace shared on stage for the latest updates on Rivals 2.

[h1]Maypul Character Reveal[/h1]

[previewyoutube=yKUH3zTNWMk;full][/previewyoutube]

Maypul joins the cast in Rivals 2 as the newest character in our 2024 launch roster! The Sylvan Watcher returns with her trusty plant companion Lily, along with 2 new friends Terry and Poppy. You can see more of her abilities in our Maypul Moveset Breakdown. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/d314f86f2e7847c04fd4b694dcbabf58a0605986.png[/img]

[h1]Rivals 2 Netcode powered by Snapnet[/h1]

We're also excited to announce that Rivals 2 will feature server-based multiplayer. To do this, we are licensing the incredible SnapNet netcode solution built by High Horse Entertainment. 

While most fighting games are peer-to-peer, moving to a server-based rollback solution gives us distinct advantages. 

The most obvious is that our 4 player lobbies will be much more responsive and stable than peer-to-peer connections would allow. This is great news for fans of team battles. 

But another huge advantage is that your own experience will be much more consistent across the player base, even in 1v1 matches. If you match up against little timmy on a 10 year-old laptop, it won’t ruin [b]your[/b] gameplay.

We were blown away by what Snapnet was able to do in our testing. Rollback netcode was a massive leap forward for the fighting game industry, and we believe that SnapNet will be another leap forward for the platform fighting genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43889344/c7e7896ccaa0a46dfe458af857830847a1816a6f.png[/img]

As we get closer to our planned 2024 release, stay up to date and support the studio by wishlisting the game. We appreciate everyone who's looking forward to Rivals 2!
